args.title: Strip BOM before splitting lines in CSV parser

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The CSV parser handles the Byte Order Mark (BOM) at the start of the text (`if (text.startsWith(BOM)) text = text.slice(BOM.length);`), but `parseStatement` splits lines into `lines` *before* stripping the BOM. When files exported from Windows tools include a leading UTF-8 BOM, `lines[0]` starts with the BOM character (`﻿date,amount,description`), causing header matching and column checks to fail on row 1. Stripping the BOM before splitting into lines will resolve this issue.
